title: Missing fallback for None environ
detail: When `HTTPException.get_response` is called with the default `environ=None`, the code no longer converts it to a proper WSGI environ. The subsequent code expects a dict-like environ, leading to a TypeError or AttributeError. The original `_get_environ` helper was removed without providing an alternative.

title: Inverted file pointer check
detail: The original code skipped processing when fp was None. The change now skips when fp is not None, causing all valid file pointers to be ignored and data not sent.
note: Describes the planted flip: every file that is set gets skipped.

title: Blocking call in async loader
detail: The _loader coroutine calls the synchronous Queue.get() method, which blocks the event loop until an item is available. This can freeze the UI and prevents other async tasks from running.
note: On the planted line, but calls get() blocking instead of seeing the dropped await.

title: Root node never loads
detail: The added guard skips adding the root node (which has data=None) to the load queue, so the root directory contents are never loaded.
